title: Legarda: Gender-based price bias banned in new ‘Anti-Pink Tax’ bill

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Have you ever observed that everyday consumer products marketed toward a specific gender are frequently more expensive than identical items targeted at another, despite being practically the same? To eradicate this inequitable pricing practice, Sen. Loren Legarda has officially filed SBN 2483, or An Act prohibiting gender-based price discrimination in consumer goods and services, otherwise known as the Anti-Pink Tax Act, a landmark consumer protection measure designed to prohibit gender-based price discrimination, addressing the systemic economic disparity where goods and services are unequally priced based solely on the gender for which they are marketed or intended.
